title: ENV/CEW GM Discovery Integration
objective: Implement the completed ENV/CEW read-only GM environment-to-creature discovery handoff in Multiversal-app while preserving canonical distribution, visibility, encounter, relationship, personhood, Havalaea autonomy, provenance and unresolved-state authority.

rules: Consume a resolved environment and ENV-HS-1.0; never re-derive or mutate environment truth.
ENV-CD-1.0 controls gate order and CEW-GM-DISC-1.0 supplies creature-side identity, ecology, distribution, personhood, Havalaea, partnership and provenance facts.
Identity and visibility must pass before distribution or ecological fit can support discovery; hidden or suppressed facts fail closed.

Ecological suitability never creates canonical distribution; unknown distribution remains unresolved and explicit absence blocks habitat-derived presence unless separately authoritative placement exists.
Can occur here is distinct from normally occurs here; normal occurrence requires independent occurrence authority beyond ecological fit.
Explicit canonical presence with incompatible or indeterminate ecology remains discoverable only as an explainable canonical-presence-conflict warning.
CEW-12/13/14/15 noncanonical libraries remain non-present by default until independent distribution authority exists.

Facets are independent, nonnumeric projections for GM filtering and never create identity, range, encounter placement, relationship state, ownership, bond, taming, domestication, personhood or NPC state.
Mount, pet, companion and familiar facets are pathway eligibility only; sapient/person-level partnership requires voluntary consent.
Havalaea sapient native fauna preserve animal ecology, autonomy and NPC projection semantics without humanoid conversion or ownership implications.
Encounter ecology is preparation/filtering only and never creates participants, placement, quantities, difficulty, tactics or live scene state.
Every result preserves gate trace and provenance; material unknowns/conflicts remain unresolved or warning states rather than being guessed away.
Projection order and deterministic receipts are stable across Linux/Windows and input ordering without introducing numeric ranking or hidden precedence.
AI remains proposal/explanation only and may not infer hidden facts, canonical range, personhood, relationship state or encounter placement.
forbidden: canonical range inference from habitat similarity
